name: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
trans: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳过了那只懒狗。

name: Practice makes perfect.
Where there is a will, there is a way.
Actions speak louder than words.
Better late than never.
Knowledge is power.
Time and tide wait for no man.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Rome was not built in a day.
All that glitters is not gold.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Honesty is the best policy.
The early bird catches the worm.
Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Two heads are better than one.
trans: 三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮。

name: It's never too late to learn.
Failure is the mother of success.
No pain, no gain.
Seeing is believing.
Easier said than done.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
Many hands make light work.
You can't judge a book by its cover.
Strike while the iron is hot.
Look before you leap.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
The grass is always greener on the other side.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
trans: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

name: Great minds think alike.
First come, first served.
Haste makes waste.
If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.
trans: 如果一开始没有成功，那就不断尝试。

name: Laughter is the best medicine.
Money doesn't grow on trees.
trans: 钱不是从天上掉下来的。

name: Necessity is the mother of invention.
Old habits die hard.
Opportunity knocks but once.
Patience is a virtue.
Slow and steady wins the race.
The best things in life are free.
trans: 生活中最好的东西是免费的。

name: There's no place like home.
trans: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

name: Tomorrow is another day.
Time flies when you're having fun.
trans: 快乐的时光总是短暂的。

name: To err is human, to forgive divine.
trans: 人非圣贤，孰能无过；宽恕则贤。

name: Well begun is half done.
trans: 良好的开端是成功的一半。

name: What goes around comes around.
You reap what you sow.
A picture is worth a thousand words.
Life is what you make it.
Dream big and dare to fail.
Stay hungry, stay foolish.
The only way out is through.
trans: 唯一的出路就是坚持到底。

name: Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
trans: 当天才不努力时，努力会战胜天才。

name: Do one thing every day that scares you.
trans: 每天做一件让你害怕的事。

name: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
trans: 幸福不是偶然，而是选择。

name: Turn your wounds into wisdom.
The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today.
trans: 对明天最好的准备就是今天做到最好。

name: It always seems impossible until it's done.
trans: 在完成之前，一切似乎都是不可能的。
